vocabulary.definition: a small tube-shaped sac attached to the large intestine, located in the lower right part of the abdomen
vocabulary.example: In some cases, the appendix may become inflamed and require surgical removal.

vocabulary.definition: a small organ below the liver that stores bile produced by the liver
vocabulary.example: After the surgery to remove her gallbladder, she had to watch her diet carefully.

vocabulary.definition: to grow back or be replaced after being damaged or lost
vocabulary.example: Certain types of lizards can regenerate their tails if they are lost or injured.

vocabulary.definition: the process of transferring tissue or organs from one person to another
vocabulary.example: The hospital has a dedicated unit for organ transplants.

vocabulary.definition: a soft fatty substance in the cavities of bones, in which blood cells are produced
vocabulary.example: Bone marrow transplants are often used to treat leukemia.

vocabulary.definition: a sudden rough movement or impact
vocabulary.example: The car hit a pothole, causing a jolt that spilled the coffee in the cup holder.
